newsitem.title: MEXICO: Vitro says could sell Anchor this month.
newsitem.headline: Vitro says could sell Anchor this month.

text.p: Mexican glass-maker Vitro could strike a deal this month to sell its U.S. subsidiary Anchor Glass Corp, a high-ranking company official said on Monday.
"I think that later this month, it will be clear which company will end up with Anchor," said the official, who wished to remain anonymous.
"We can specify amounts or the interested parties, but toward the end of this month we will have all that information," the official told Reuters in an interview.
Vitro officially put Anchor, the third-largest company in the U.S. glass container industry, on the auction block in June.
Vitro hopes to use the money from the sale to reduce its debt load and focus on more profitable core businesses in Mexico and elsewhere, the official said.
-- Maria Luisa Aguilar, Mexico City newsroom 525 7289553
